context: A boss reviews market strategy with his manager
purpose: Teach: デフレ/クレジットカード/コンサルティング/譲渡/公益/年収/出品/営利

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 賢治君、現状はデフレ脱却が見えないから、来期の市場戦略を根本から見直したい。
lines.en: Kenji, since we don't see a way out of deflation, I want to fundamentally rethink next term's market strategy.
lines.style: Authoritative boss tone, calm but firm, slightly weary

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 承知しました。実はクレジットカード決済の手数料が利益を圧迫しているという報告も上がっています。
lines.en: Understood. Actually, there are reports that credit card payment fees are squeezing our profits.
lines.style: Professional manager voice, respectful, presenting facts directly

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: それなら、外部の経営コンサルティング会社に分析を依頼してみたらどうだ？
lines.en: In that case, how about asking an outside management consulting firm to analyze it?
lines.style: Thoughtful questioning, mid-pace, suggesting an option

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 良い案だと思います。ただ、不採算部門の事業譲渡も同時に検討すべきかと。
lines.en: I think that's a good idea. However, I believe we should also consider divesting the unprofitable divisions.
lines.style: Cautious but assertive, measured pacing, slight hesitation

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほどな。ついでに公益法人向けの新サービスも、収益の柱になり得るぞ。
lines.en: I see. By the way, new services aimed at public interest corporations could also become a revenue pillar.
lines.style: Engaged and energized, leaning forward, brainstorming aloud

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。営業部の平均年収を底上げするためにも、新規顧客の開拓は急務です。
lines.en: Exactly as you say. To raise the average annual income of the sales department, acquiring new customers is urgent.
lines.style: Earnest agreement, slightly more passionate, advocating for team

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ECサイトへの出品も増やそう。営利目的の事業展開を、もっと攻めの姿勢でやっていこう。
lines.en: Let's also increase our listings on EC sites. We need to pursue our for-profit business expansion more aggressively.
lines.style: Decisive closing statement, motivating tone, building momentum

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: かしこまりました。週末までに具体的なアクションプランを作成いたします。
lines.en: Certainly. I will prepare a concrete action plan by the weekend.
lines.style: Polite, committed closing reply, respectful and decisive
